auth.label: API Token
auth.description: Xingpan access_token for chart calculations. See https://www.xingpan.vip/astrology/Apiinterface for the limited test token; contact official WeChat xingpanvip to obtain a production token and confirm access and quotas.

actions.name: calculate_comparison_chart
actions.description: Calculate a comparison chart for two people, including both planetary sets and their relationship to the houses.

birthday.description: Local birth date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm or YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude in degrees, positive east and negative west.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude in degrees, positive north and negative south.

timezone.description: UTC offset in hours at this local date and time, including historical daylight saving time. Omit to look it up from Xingpan; an explicit value, including 0, is preserved.

items.description: Birth details in local civil time at the birthplace.

people.description: The two people's birth details in the requested order; their order affects comparison charts.

items.description: A Xingpan planet ID, such as 0 for the Sun or D for Chiron.

planets.description: Planet IDs from get_chart_config; defaults to the Sun, Moon, and eight other major planets (0 through 9).

asteroids.description: Additional asteroid IDs from get_chart_config, such as xs433 for Eros.

virtualPoints.description: Virtual point IDs from get_chart_config, such as 10 for the Ascendant.

houseSystem.description: House system code; defaults to K (Koch). Other systems include P (Placidus) and W (Whole sign).

chartStyle.description: SVG chart style. Defaults to none for data-only output; basic or advanced includes the chart SVG.

additionalProperties.description: Allowed orb in degrees for this aspect angle.

aspectOrbs.description: Aspect angle to allowed orb in degrees, for example {"90":2}. Omit to use upstream defaults.

inputSchema.description: Input for calculating a chart for exactly two people.

chart.description: Complete upstream chart data with access tokens removed. Native fields include planet, house, sign, attribute, optional svg, and planet_second for comparison or transit charts; return charts may include return_time or user.turn_date.

inputSchema.description: Input for fetching Xingpan chart configuration.

config.description: Upstream configuration maps and lists, including planets, virtual, planet_xs, planet_xf, planetEnglish, planetChinese, and zodiac names.

actions.name: get_daily_horoscope
actions.description: Get daily zodiac horoscopes for one sign or all twelve signs, including overall, love, career, health, scores, and lucky items.

date.description: Requested date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit to use the provider's current day.

sign.description: Zodiac sign to query. Omit to return all twelve signs.

inputSchema.description: Input for fetching daily zodiac horoscopes; birth details are not needed.

items.description: One upstream horoscope, including sign, date, overall, love, career, health, score fields, and lucky items; new upstream fields are preserved.

outputSchema.description: Daily zodiac horoscopes normalized to a list for both single-sign and all-sign requests.
